tasks.label: docker compose build (current module)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'F=${file}; SVC=$(echo "$F" | sed -n "s|.*/modules/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p"); if [ -z "$SVC" ]; then echo "current file not under modules/"; exit 1; fi; echo "=== build module: $SVC ==="; cd ${workspaceFolder} && docker compose build $SVC'

tasks.label: 🔁 build + up + logs (current module)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'F=${file}; SVC=$(echo "$F" | sed -n "s|.*/modules/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p"); if [ -z "$SVC" ]; then echo "current file not under modules/"; exit 1; fi; cd ${workspaceFolder} && docker compose build $SVC && docker compose up -d $SVC && docker compose logs -f --tail=30 $SVC'
tasks.detail: 改完代码后一键：build 当前模块 → 重启容器 → 跟日志（Ctrl+C 退出日志不杀容器）

tasks.label: docker compose up -d (gui profile)
tasks.command: xhost +local:docker >/dev/null 2>&1; docker compose --profile gui up -d gui

tasks.label: docker compose logs (current module)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'F=${file}; SVC=$(echo "$F" | sed -n "s|.*/modules/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p"); if [ -z "$SVC" ]; then SVC=monitor; fi; docker compose logs -f --tail=50 $SVC'

tasks.label: exec into module (bash)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'F=${file}; SVC=$(echo "$F" | sed -n "s|.*/modules/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p"); if [ -z "$SVC" ]; then SVC=monitor; fi; docker compose exec $SVC bash'

tasks.label: docker build GUI 镜像 + 重启
tasks.command: xhost +local:docker >/dev/null 2>&1; docker compose --profile gui build mentorpi_pc_gui && docker compose --profile gui up -d mentorpi_pc_gui && docker logs -f mentorpi_gui
